title: Configure workflow schemes
content:
A workflow scheme defines a set of associations – or mappings – between a workflow and a work type. As a Jira administrator, you can associate work types with different workflows within a workflow schemes and then share this association with multiple spaces.
Add a workflow scheme
- Select Settings, then Work items.
- Under WORKFLOWS, select Workflow Schemes.
- Select Add Workflow Scheme.
- Enter the name and description of the new workflow scheme.
- Select Add to create the new workflow scheme.
Configure workflows for a workflow scheme
If your scheme is already associated with a single space, follow the instructions in Configuring a workflow scheme associated with a space. If you want to configure a workflow scheme shared by multiple spaces, skip to Configuring a workflow scheme outside of a space. Keep in mind that changing a shared workflow scheme will affect all spaces using that scheme.
Default workflow schemes cannot be configured. To change these schemes, you can create a copy or associate your spaces with a different scheme.
Configure a workflow scheme associated with a space
- Select Settings, then Spaces.
- Go to the relevant space.
- Next to the name of your space in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Space settings.
- Select Workflows to configure your space's workflow scheme as needed.
- When you're ready to publish your workflow, select Associate to begin the migration process.
- Select Acknowledge and you're done.
| What do you want to do? | Steps | 
|---|---|
| Add a workflow to the scheme | 1. Select Add Workflow, and select Add Existing. 2. Select the desired workflow and work types. | 
| Edit a workflow | Hover over the desired workflow and select Edit. See Working with workflows for further instructions. Note that you must have the edit workflow permission. | 
| Remove a workflow from the scheme | Select the cross icon under Operations to remove the workflow from the scheme. | 
| Change the work types associated with a workflow | 1. Select Assign under Work Types for the desired workflow. 2. Select the desired work types in the dialog that appears. 3. Select Finish. | 
| View the text-based representation of a workflow | Hover over the desired workflow, and click View as Text. | 
| Change the workflow scheme associated with the space | Select Switch Scheme next to the scheme name. See Managing your workflows for further instructions. | 
Configure a workflow scheme outside of a space
You can use this procedure to edit any workflow scheme in the system, including those shared by multiple spaces. The workflow scheme can be either active or inactive. Note that editing active workflow schemes will automatically create a draft so you don't impact existing work.
- Select Settings, then Work items.
- Under WORKFLOWS, select Workflow Schemes.
- Select Edit for the relevant workflow.
- Edit your workflow scheme as needed.
- Publish your draft to make your changes active.
| What do you want to do? | Steps | 
|---|---|
| Add a workflow to the scheme | 1. Select Add Workflow, and select Add Existing. 2. Select the desired workflow and work types. | 
| Remove a workflow from the scheme | Select Remove in the Operations column. | 
| Change the work types associated with a workflow | 1. Select Assign under Work Types for the desired workflow. 2. Select the desired work types. 3. Select Finish. | 
| View a representation of a workflow | Select either the text or diagram link next to the workflow name. | 
| Remove a work type from the scheme | Select the x next to the name of the work type to remove it. | 
Edit, copy, and delete workflow schemes
- Select Settings, then Work items.
- Under WORKFLOWS, select Workflow Schemes.
- Check out the following options:
| What do you want to do? | Steps | 
|---|---|
| Edit the name and description of a workflow scheme | Select Edit. Use inline edit mode – click in the associated field – to update the name and description. | 
| Copy a workflow scheme | Select Copy to create a workflow scheme with the prefix "Copy of (name of current workflow)" and placed in the inactive workflow schemes. | 
| Delete a workflow scheme | Select Delete and confirm the deletion. You cannot delete an active workflow scheme. You must first disassociate it from all spaces. | 
Associate workflow schemes with a space
Check out Managing your workflows for more information about enabling your workflow configuration by associating a scheme with a space.
